channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
item.description: Anthropic held its historic Nasdaq debut a day before Nvidia's stock closed out its longest weekly losing streak since 2008.

item.title: Trump says there could be a 'positive spin' from the latest FBI database hack
item.description: This would make the second recent intrusion into the FBI system.

item.title: Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy
item.description: Recent technology outages have left some worried about AI cyberattacks and the U.S. electricity grid. The doomsday economy is heating up as a result.

item.title: State and federal battle over prediction markets regulation heats up after midterms
item.description: States, Congress and the CFTC are escalating the fight over prediction market regulation after the midterms.

item.title: International first class is over for U.S. airlines. Enter the mega business-class cabin
item.description: Airlines are opting to build giant business-class cabins with ever-more luxurious suites.

item.description: Several stocks that are unpopular on Wall Street, including Clorox, Boston Beer and Campbell's, are poised to be winners as the AI trade loses steam.

item.title: Warren Buffett quadruples Thanksgiving gifts: A breakdown of how much wealth he's giving away
item.description: Warren Buffett more than quadrupled his Thanksgiving donations to four family foundations this year to $5.5 billion.

item.title: An ‘illusion of glitz and glamour’: Inside California’s modern-day gold rush, where miners can bring in millions
item.description: The price of gold has sparked a modern-day gold rush in California. Small-scale miners are investing time, physical labor and money to unearth the yellow metal.

item.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Lutnick
item.description: President Donald Trump, when asked by CNBC's Eamon Javers, said he has not lost confidence in Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

item.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has faced a flurry of criticism on Capitol Hill in the wake of his involvement with a suspected Chinese spy.

item.title: UK maritime agency reports two tanker attacks near Oman; Iran says vessel hit mine east of Hormuz
item.description: The incidents followed a similar attack on a tanker near Khasab on Friday that caused a fire on board, according to the British maritime security agency.

item.title: Retirees face a looming deadline for required withdrawals — missing it could trigger a tax penalty
item.description: The busy holiday season may lead retirees to miss a key deadline for retirement account withdrawals.

item.title: Mexico captures top drug lord 'El Chapo Isidro,' latest in string of arrests
item.description: For over 20 years, according to the U.S. officials, his criminal organization smuggled heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine, and marijuana into the U.S.

item.description: The Sparta II was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland's Defence Forces said.

item.description: Cybersecurity companies have been hunting for acquisitions in the AI era.

item.description: The brutal sell-off is creating opportunities for us to put cash to work.

item.title: Take-Two shatters sales record as 'GTA VI' launches to massive fanfare

item.title: FBI's criminal information database hacked, CNN reports

item.title: Europe's cyber weak spot is the everyday businesses nobody thought to protect
item.description: Known vulnerabilities are leaving everyday businesses increasingly exposed to cyber sabotage, as AI enables cybercriminals to work better and faster.

item.title: Countries agree to U.N. talks aiming to regulate 'killer robots' by 2028
item.description: Around 100 countries backed legally binding rules within a short timeframe but big arms-producing nations like the U.S., Russia and Israel opposed this position.

item.title: Meta's India offices hit by opposition protests over account removals
item.description: Prime Minister Modi's government says it orders content to be taken down only if it breaches local laws, or can harm public safety or national security.
